subject: Confirming remediation for penetration findings and scheduling revalidation
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmecloud.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Cc: security@acmecloud.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test findings closure — request for confirmation and revalidation window

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the thorough pen test debrief earlier this month. Our InfoSec team completed an internal review of the remediation tickets you provided and we have a few outstanding asks before we schedule a full revalidation:

- A concise remediation confirmation letter that states which CVEs/IEs were addressed and the date of the fix deployment.
- Any evidence artifacts (scan reports or short runbooks) that show the fix was applied to staging and production.
- A proposed 2-hour window in the next two weeks for our revalidation team to run a limited verification re-scan.

Can you provide the confirmation letter and a short list of evidence items by EOD Thursday? If you can also propose two possible windows (in PDT), we'll try to lock one down.

Appreciate the help — we want to keep the SOC 2 timeline on track.

Best,
Alex Turner
Security Manager, AcmeCloud

--
AcmeCloud security@acmecloud.com
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmecloud.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test findings closure — request for confirmation and revalidation window

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the clear list. Attached is a short remediation confirmation that summarizes the work tied to the three prioritized findings (low/med/high). Key points:

- All fixes were deployed to our staging cluster on 2027-08-09 UTC and promoted to a controlled production rollout on 2027-08-11 UTC.
- We have automated smoke checks and a targeted regression test suite that ran during and after the rollout.
- Evidence bundle (referenced below) contains staging/production scan snapshots, pull request IDs, and the mitigation playbooks.

Proposed verification windows (PDT):
- Monday 2027-08-16 09:00–11:00
- Wednesday 2027-08-18 13:00–15:00

Attachments (stubs):
- remediation-summary-ACME-2027-08-12.pdf (signed confirmation letter)
- fix-checklist-ACME.csv (ticket IDs + PRs + deploy timestamps)
- evidence-bundle-urls.txt (short links to Drive + CI artifacts)

Vivek from our security team is CC'd for any technical clarifications. If those windows don't work, tell us your preference and we'll adapt.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0128

---
Attachments: remediation-summary-ACME-2027-08-12.pdf (application/pdf), fix-checklist-ACME.csv (text/csv), evidence-bundle-urls.txt (text/plain)
From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmecloud.com>, jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test findings closure — request for confirmation and revalidation window

Alex, Jasmine —

Quick technical note on the verification scope so your team can prepare:

1) The remediation labeled HIGH-01 was a configuration change to the reverse proxy header parsing. We have included the patch PR (PR#792) and staging/production NGINX conf snapshots in the Drive links. That change is non-destructive — revalidation should focus on the original exploit vector test and a regression run.

2) MED-02 and LOW-03 had code fixes plus follow-up unit tests. Logs from the post-deploy regression run (timestamps included in fix-checklist-ACME.csv) show zero failures across the targeted suite.

3) We'll provide a short read-only account with two IP allowlisted ranges for your re-scan. Please confirm the IPs you will test from so we can update the firewall before the window.

Suggested test window that balances our release cadence:
- Wednesday 2027-08-18 13:00–15:00 PDT (preferred)

Also attaching a one-page delta attestation template we typically use for follow-up validations — this lets you capture a brief statement about whether the fix scope changed test methodology. If you plan to issue your own formal delta report, please share the expected deliverable so we can align.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachments: delta-attestation-template-ACME.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmecloud.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test findings closure — request for confirmation and revalidation window

Hi Alex —

Thanks — we locked the verification window for Wednesday 2027-08-18 13:00–15:00 PDT as Vivek recommended. Next steps:

1) Please confirm the external test IPs so we can allowlist them by EOD Monday.
2) We have shared the Drive folder (link below) with the evidence bundle and a read-only account for validation. Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3RemediationEvidence
3) We will provide a short post-validation delta attestation based on your summary result (template attached to Vivek's message). If your revalidation results in residual findings, escalate to security@redwood.com and we'll triage immediately.

DocuSign link for the remediation confirmation letter (signed by our VP Security) has been sent to your security mailbox; you can sign directly or reply with comments.

If anything changes before Wednesday, ping me directly. Appreciate the coordinated approach.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
